# Billing Service

## Purpose
The Billing Service handles financial operations, including invoice generation, payment processing, and charge management.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Invoice** | `/plugins/Invoice/getAllInvoices` | POST | Lists all invoices with filtering and pagination. |
| **Invoice** | `/plugins/Invoice/createInvoice` | POST | Creates a new invoice. |
| **Invoice** | `/plugins/Invoice/updateInvoice` | PUT | Updates an existing invoice. |
| **Payment** | `/plugins/Payment/getAllPayments` | POST | Lists all payments. |
| **Charge** | `/plugins/Charge/getAllCharges` | POST | Lists all charges. |
| **PaymentMethod**| `/plugins/PaymentMethod/getAllPaymentMethods` | POST | Lists available payment methods. |

## Dependencies
- **billing-model**: Provides the core data structures.
- **pricing-model**: Used for money and currency representations.
- **flexicore-boot**: Base framework for plugin support.

## Interesting Features
- **Extensible Payment Methods**: Supports multiple payment method types (Credit Card, Bank Transfer, etc.).
- **Automated Invoicing**: Logic for linking multiple charges into a single invoice.
- **Linkage to Pricing**: Direct integration with the `pricing-model` to ensure consistent currency handling.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as InvoiceController
    participant Service as InvoiceService
    participant Repository as InvoiceRepository

    User->>Controller: createInvoice(InvoiceCreate)
    Controller->>Service: validate(InvoiceCreate)
    Service->>Service: calculateTotals()
    Service->>Repository: merge(Invoice)
    Repository-->>User: Invoice Created
```
